mu_name_from: ZzzOpenData.cpp:115-120: MODEL_BODY_HELM + i and its fellows load HelmClass{i+1}, ArmorClass{i+1} and the rest, and a character with no armour wears MODEL_BODY_* + SkinIndex (ZzzCharacter.cpp:12124-12346), numbered one over MU's zero-based classes -- so Class05 is the Dark Lord, class 4.
part_note: The head, 634 triangles. Bound to 466 on Bip01 Head, 14 on Bip01 Spine1. The Spine1 ring is taken onto the head by rebind, as on the other S17 heads.
sheet_from: Data/Player/HQlevel_man02.OZJ (256x256), from the Season 17 client (third_party/MuClient_S17_v1.19.74). All five of the Dark Lord's parts name it. The head also names Data/Player/HQhair_R.OZJ (128x128, white hair on black) for its 156-triangle hair shell.
additive_from: A texture named _R is MuMain's Bright mesh (TextureScript.cpp:38-39): drawn added. The user, 2026-10-23: "DL has to be true on actual MU".
separate_meshes_why: The hair shell is its own mesh in the S17 file; kept apart so it is not welded into the head.
cull_from: As HelmClass02: MU's hair is flat single-sided fins, and culled they wink out as the head turns (HelmClass02.json's cull_note).
model_from: Season 17's remake of MU's Dark Lord body, read out of Data/Player/HelmClass05.bmd in the S17 client: a version-14 file, which MuExtract opens through Webzen's ModulusCryptor (pipeline/MuExtract/MuAssets/Crypto). The user, 2026-10-23: "we are taking naked skins from MuClient_S17_v1.19.74". Its 51 bones are the first 51 of player.bmd's, by name and order, so it rides our rig and clips as the other classes' do.
rebind_from: As HelmClass02's: every S17 head binds a ring at the base of the neck to Bip01 Spine1, two joints down, and the head turns a long way from the chest in MU's poses; taken onto the head, as on every S17 head (the user, 2026-10-15).
material_note: hair for the white mane, skin for the face and neck; the separate HQhair_R shell added, as MU's bright mesh.

uv_overrides.why: The face block, under the hair.
The ear and neck block, top middle.

uv_overrides_why: The white mane and the face share shells; the islands are hair and the face, ear and neck are lifted out. Read off the sheet with the UV layout drawn over it (2026-10-23).
